description: 实现 motor-control-enhancement v2.5：新增电机设备类型与多端口语义闭环，并采用 motor 旧写法破坏性迁移（不做兼容层）。

lowering 继续输出二值 IR，非法值在 lowering 前拦截
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: runtime_bridge 完成多端口输出路由
userStories.description: As a runtime engineer, I want output resolution keyed by device and port so multi-port devices do not alias.
acceptanceCriteria: resolve_digital_output_id 接口支持 device+port 路由
convert_action 调用链传递 TransitionAction::Set.port
stepper.enable 与 stepper.direction 路由到不同物理通道
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented: runtime_bridge now resolves outputs by device+port using topology links (with safe fallback), and added regression in tests/runtime_bridge_us006.rs for stepper enable/direction channel split.

userStories.notes: Implemented: safety model now indexes (device,port), port-aware rule binding/action effects are enabled, and cross-port conflict regression added in src/verification/safety.rs tests.
